title: Teaching Claude how to make a trailer on its own - first super rough cut
author: fapfap_ahh
selftext:
New workflow I've been tuning for my AI gamekit, being able to have Claude (or any AI) curate a list of scenes and their music, then have it record and edit it for a "rough cut" trailer on its own.

Did a (imo) terrible job because of the sound mismatches and weird transitions but good first test for me! 

It essentially takes the scenes I've curated, combines dev console commands to set it up (time, weather, hud, give wood, arm ak47, etc), then runs a scripted record that pipes audio and video straight into FFMPEG. Then it uses ffmpeg itself for the editing.
